text:
IncidentBot: HIGH latency/error spike observed for model variant `quant-eu-v1` in eu-west-1 (p95 latency -> 2.3s, 5xx rate -> 6.8%). Auto-alerting because >= 5% keys exceed error threshold. PagerDuty: incident #INC-4129 created.
Sam: I'm oncall, acking PD. Pulling up dashboards. Any customer-reported hits? @EngOps pls FYI.
EngOps: seeing correlated retry floods from a few heavy API keys (org: FinlexCorp). Top verbs are generation + streaming.
Maria: Finlex support ticket 5821 shows degraded responses since ~11:44 UTC. They reported timeouts and partial payloads.
Sam: OK. Priority = P1 (customer-impacting). Plan: (1) shift routing for eu to stable unquantized variant `stable-eu-v1` for all non-burst traffic, (2) apply emergency per-key quota for the heavy keys, (3) monitor for 30m then decide. Any objections?
Alex: +1. Suggest also temporarily disable KV-cache prefetch on quant variant to reduce memory pressure while switching.
Jin: I'm ready to run the routing change. Preparing commands now.
Sam: Do it. Post exact commands and wait for an ack.
Jin: Running:
```bash
# promote stable variant for eu routing policy
redwoodctl routing promote --region eu-west-1 --from quant-eu-v1 --to stable-eu-v1 --percentage 100
```
Jin: executed at 11:52:03 UTC. API returned 200 and route status "applied".
IncidentBot: Route change detected by control-plane. Old variant still draining. New target weight: stable-eu-v1 = 100%.
Alex: Confirming traffic shift in envoy: 95% of new connects going to stable-eu-v1. Error rate on quant-eu-v1 spiked down.
Sam: Now applying emergency per-key quotas for top offending keys (50 req/min). Commands:
```bash
# set emergency quota for Finlex keys
redwoodctl quota set --api-key fk_ABC123 --region eu-west-1 --rate 50/m --reason "incident mitigation"
redwoodctl quota set --api-key fk_DEF456 --region eu-west-1 --rate 50/m --reason "incident mitigation"
```
EngOps: Quotas applied. Noted a drop in overall request volume from those keys.
Maria: Finlex says they're seeing immediate improvement for some requests. Still intermittently slow for long context calls.
Sam: Pulling logs for any internal 5xx reasons.
Alex: Found a spike of OOM kills on a subset of quant-eu-v1 pods prior to the alert. Logs: 
```
[2024-06-27T11:48:59Z] quant-worker-7: OOMKilled while allocating KV cache for seq_len=4096
[2024-06-27T11:49:01Z] quant-worker-7: restarting pod
```
Jin: That matches the memory pressure hypothesis. Quantized variant memory tuning regressed after last runtime tweak.
Sam: Next steps: keep quant variant isolated (no new traffic), continue draining, set incident page to SRE for kernel/oom debug. Maria, loop in customer success for Finlex comms. Alex/Jin you pair on reproducer for OOM.
Maria: On it. CS pinged Finlex with a short update: investigating, we've routed you to a stable variant and applied temporary limits. ETA next update in 20m.
EngOps: Enabling temporary circuit-break on quant-eu-v1 to prevent inadvertent fallback loops. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl circuit set --variant quant-eu-v1 --region eu-west-1 --fail-open=false --max-conns 10
```
EngOps: circuit applied.
IncidentBot: Monitoring: p95 latency for eu decreased from 2.3s -> 0.95s within 3m of routing change. 5xx rate down to 0.9%.
Sam: Good. Keeping incident open for postmortem. Action items assigned:
- Alex/Jin: capture repro and patch runtime tuning (inc-4129-1).
- EngOps: collect pod core dumps and attach to ticket (inc-4129-2).
- Maria/CS: continue customer updates and confirm Finlex satisfaction (inc-4129-3).
- Sam: coordinate rollback of latest runtime kernel tweak if patch isn't quick (inc-4129-4).
Alex: Quick note: we shouldn't roll out a global rollback yet — scope looks limited to quant-eu-v1. We'll triage root cause first.
Sam: Agreed. For now, quant-eu-v1 remains disabled for new traffic in eu-west-1. We'll keep the variant in read-only/drain mode.
Jin: Documenting commands I ran in the incident ticket and attaching config diffs.
Maria: Finlex reports degraded but acceptable behaviour and asked for timeline. CS suggests weekly follow-up until fix.
Sam: Closing loop for now: if metrics remain stable for 30m we'll switch to monitoring-only and update CS. If regression or new customers impacted, escalate to postmortem and urgent patch.
IncidentBot: Next automated status update in 15m. PagerDuty: incident still open and acknowledged by Sam.
Sam: Thanks team. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your action items.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Jin: :thumbsup:
EngOps: :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Sam: Logging this thread into the incident ticket and beginning timeline section.
